config.prompt: Your step: Attach and confirm the trade lawyer's written opinion approving the flat-fee broker model. This gate must pass before any broker contract or broker portal launch. Glacier will not contact a lawyer, sign a contract, create an account, or submit CPSC filings.

Your step: Review and approve the first broker contract. Confirm that it charges only a flat monthly fee and contains no refund commission or attorney fee split. Glacier will not sign or send the contract.
